newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Cable & Wireless unit in Indonesia venture.
newsitem.headline: Cable & Wireless unit in Indonesia venture.

text.p: A unit of British telecommunications firm Cable and Wireless Plc announced a joint venture on Friday with Indonesian firm PT Trikora Lloyd, part of the Boedihardjo transport and shipping group.
The new company, PT MaCaSer Indonesia, has been set up to install and service a network of submarine cables in the Indonesian archipelago, said president director Reginald Ross.
"Use of fibre optic cables will be important to connect Indonesia," Ross said, adding that his company will be working closely with domestic telecoms operators PT Telkom and PT Indosat.
PT Trikora Lloyd will hold a 45 percent stake in the joint venture and the British company, Cable and Wireless Marine, 55 percent, with an initial capital outlay of US$1 million.
